statement.p: Match the planar vector field \mathbf{F} = \left\lt 4 x + 4, y\right> with the corresponding plot in the Figures below.

static.solution: ( 0,4 ), for instance, and identify the corresponding graph accordingly: \mathbf{F} ( x,y )= \left\lt 4 x+4,y \right> \quad\Rightarrow\quad \mathbf{F} ( 0,4 )= \left\lt 4,4 \right>\quad\Rightarrow\quad \text{Plot(1)}
